The pesto sauce chicken rice soup comes separately in two bowls.
The flavor is hearty, and the dish is filling. It has chunks of potato, carrot, chicken and mushrooms. The soup is very good and well seasoned.
At first, I didn’t know how the rice soup will taste, so here is my take on it: imagine a saucy risotto. After mixing the soup into the rice, it becomes a wet risotto. But good risotto.
The pork belly lunch box is also very good, but a little greasier by the end, so consider the oil-cutting tea as an addition.
